# GET /api/v1/orgs

Get list of all organizations visible to the current user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** optional (token enhances visibility) · **ID:** `ep-029`

| limit | query | integer | False |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Visibility filtering for org listing: anonymous sees public only, authenticated sees public+limited, admin sees all | authorization | ctx.IsSigned && !ctx.PublicOnly → add VisibleTypeLimited; ctx.Doer.IsAdmin → add VisibleTypePrivate |
